name: Cyclotron
description:
While charging faster than 15 m/s, slain enemy drops are atomized, often converting to primordial dust, which can then be crafted with crystals or socketing gems to duplicate them.

Faster than 15 m/s: Effects will play while you are charging fast enough to atomize items
Crystals: Lapis Lazuli, Nether Quarts, Amethyst Shards, Prismarine Shards, Diamonds, and Emeralds.
